short_description: Turn product ideas into testable requirements.
description: Create product requirements documents with scope, user stories, measurable acceptance criteria, technical constraints, and risk analysis.

requires: Authorized SandBase connection for capability calls

install.prompt: Use $prd to turn this product idea into an implementation-ready PRD.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill prd --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill prd --agent codex --global

examples: Write a PRD for this feature idea.
Research current technical constraints and mark unresolved decisions as TBD.
notes: Call sandbase_inspect before each capability and pass only current schema-defined arguments.
Do not mutate external systems without explicit user authorization.

schema_resolution.dynamic_lookup: Use tool_name as a discovery hint with sandbase_discover; pass the matching returned name to sandbase_inspect and follow execute_as with the current inputSchema.

endpoints.summary: Read a selected page as clean Markdown.
